results.content:
CALGARY, Alberta, Aug. 06, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Pulse Seismic Inc. (TSX:PSD) (OTCQX:PLSDF) (“Pulse” or the “Company”) announces a CEO transition effective August 6, 2026. Pamela Wicks, CPA, ICD.D, currently Vice President, Finance and Chief Financial Officer, has been appointed President and Chief Executive Officer of the Company.

“As Pulse’s longest tenured executive, Pamela brings extensive experience in the seismic data library industry and deep knowledge of Pulse’s business to the CEO role” said Robert Robotti, Chair of the Board. “The Board believes Pamela’s proven leadership track record makes her the ideal candidate to execute Pulse’s business strategy while providing continuity for shareholders, customers and our dedicated team of professionals.” [...] For further information, please contact:  
Pamela Wicks, President and CEO

## FAQ

### What leadership change did Pulse Seismic (PLSDF) announce on August 6, 2026?

Pulse Seismic announced that Pamela Wicks was appointed President and Chief Executive Officer effective August 6, 2026. According to Pulse Seismic, she moves into the top role from her prior positions as Vice President, Finance and Chief Financial Officer, providing leadership continuity.

### Who is Pamela Wicks, the new CEO of Pulse Seismic (PLSDF)? [...] The Board has started a process to identify a new Chief Financial Officer. According to Pulse Seismic, Pamela Wicks will temporarily continue to oversee the company’s finance function, supported by an experienced finance team, to ensure continuity during the leadership transition period.

### Did Neal Coleman leave Pulse Seismic (PLSDF) in the August 2026 CEO transition?

Yes. In conjunction with the appointment of Pamela Wicks as President and CEO, Neal Coleman stepped down from his role as President and Chief Executive Officer. According to Pulse Seismic, the Board thanked him for his leadership and contributions and wished him well.

## Pamela Wicks, CPA, CMA, ICD.D

Ms. Wicks was appointed President and CEO of Pulse in August 2026. She was previously  the VP Finance and CFO of the company and will continue as the acting CFO during the search for her replacement.  Ms. Wicks joined Pulse Seismic Inc. in 2002 as Corporate Controller, was promoted to Vice President of Finance in 2007, and was appointed Chief Financial Officer in 2010. [...] ## Melanie Westergaard

Ms. Westergaard is an independent businessperson with over 38 years of global experience in the oil and gas industry. She began her career in the geophysical services industry with Western Geophysical, followed by more than 18 years with the multinational oil company ARCO/BP, where she held roles ranging from geophysicist to multi-asset management and leadership positions. Ms. Westergaard further honed her geophysical and managerial expertise across a variety of geologic basins, pursuing both unconventional and conventional play types with Forest Oil, Ovintiv, and as a consultant for a number of oil and gas operators. [...] Mr. Droppo has served as a director, trustee, or officer of numerous oil and gas companies, including TriStar Oil & Gas Ltd., Real Resources Inc., Burmis Energy Inc., Pembina Pipeline Income Fund, Iteration Energy Ltd., Norex Exploration Services Inc., and Mart Resources Inc.

Mr. Droppo obtained a Bachelor of Science in Geology from the University of Calgary and a Bachelor of Laws (LL.B.) from the University of Alberta. Mr. Droppo also received the ICD.D designation from the Institute of Corporate Directors.

Mr. Droppo is Chair of Pulse’s Corporate Governance and Nominating Committee and serves as a member of the Audit and Risk Committee, and the Compensation Committee.
